messages:
Eva: Customer ACME reports a sudden vectors/sec drop for embeddings since 00:30 UTC — tokens/sec looks steady but vectors/sec down ~80%. No obvious 5xx in their app, but increased client-side retries. Their account: acme-inc, model: rwd-embed-large-v2. Logs: https://logs.redwood/acme/24912 (redacted)
Anya: Can you paste a request sample and the exact error they see? Also which variant did routing pick (gpu/quant/cpu)?
Eva: Pasting condensed logs from the edge + runtime below:
```
edge: request id=xyz123 model=rwd-embed-large-v2 variant=quant-gpu route=zone-us-east
runtime: queue_depth=0->128 spike at 00:31
runtime: fallback_variant=cpu-quantized reason=kvcache_miss latency_mult=6
metrics: tokens_sec=11.9k (ok), vectors_sec=2.4k (was ~12k)
client: 429s started showing after retries, but initial reported symptom was throughput drop
```
Eva: No explicit "dimension mismatch" in these logs. Customer did mention they send batches of 16 with dim=1536.
Raj: We rolled the autoscaler/batching tweak yesterday (canary) that lowered batching window to 1ms for low-latency SLAs. That change can reduce effective batch sizes for embeddings and trigger frequent fallback to CPU variants when GPU KV cache misses increase.
Mike: GPU telemetry shows the following for the impacted pool (pool-id: ap-east-emb-3):
- 00:25-00:30 avg queue_depth=6, avg_batch_size=12
- 00:30-00:35 spike queue_depth->128 then a collapse to avg_batch_size=2
- GPU util dropped from 78% -> 22% while CPU queues rose
Looks like thundering micro-batches causing kvcache pressure and variant fallback.
Anya: That matches. Quick repro: curl they can run to replicate (small fake text):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-large-v2","input":["a","b",...],"batch_size":16}'
```
Anya: Temporary mitigation we should try for the customer: bump batching window to 50ms for their route or pin to a GPU-rich variant. Config snippet to apply in routing/overrides:
```
route_overrides:
  acme-inc:
    batching:
      max_window_ms: 50
      max_batch_tokens: 65536
    routing:
      preferred_variant: quant-gpu
```
Raj: Agree. Longer term: revert the 1ms global change or make it per-route; embeddings workloads need larger proto-batches to achieve vectors/sec targets. Also add an autoscaler KPI to avoid pool collapse when kvcache miss rate > X%.
deploy-bot: Deployed config rollback candidate: rollout/emb-batch-window-2491 -> state: canary -> id: roll-2491-embatch
Mike: I'll bump min_replicas for ap-east-emb-3 by +2 and watch queue_depth. Can we scope a rollback to the global batching tweak if metrics don't improve in 15m?
Eva: I'll message the customer with repro steps and ask them to run the curl. Telling them we've applied a per-route override (max_window_ms=50) to their account and to expect improvement. Will update in 10m. :thumbsup:
Anya: If the customer still sees slow vectors/sec after the override, capture a raw payload (redact PII) + full edge/runtime trace. We may need to force a variant pin to gpu-quant and capture KV cache stats.
Eva: thanks team — will monitor and post results here.
